Name: Prismatic Tools - Better Resources and Better Gems and Minerals Retexture
Author: UnknownWren
Description:
[color=#3d85c6][font=Georgia][size=5][b]Details[/b][/size][/font]
[/color]
This is just a quick compatibility texture replacement I threw together so that the prismatic bar from "Prismatic Tools Continued" would match the style of the "Better Resources" and "Better Gems and Minerals" mods.

RECOMMENDED USEAGE WITH [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8835?tab=description]GRANDPA'S TOOLS[/url] BY GWENIACZEK
(Use the commented patch by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SrEthryan]SrEthryan[/url] to allow GT to work with the Stardew 1.6﻿ update.)

[b][font=Georgia][color=#3d85c6][size=5]Installation[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[b]
[size=3]Manual download ONLY! It is just a .png file!!
[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Unzip the file.
[*]Replace the prismaticBar.png image in .../Stardew Valley/Mods/PrismaticTools/assets with the image supplied in this download.
[*]Let the new png override the original.
[/list]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6942?tab=description]Better Resources[/url] by cometkins
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5443]Better Gems and Minerals[/url] by cometkins
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450?tab=description]Prismatic Tools Continued[/url] by iargue
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Tools[/url] by stokastic (currently unmaintained and deprecated, use the iargue version!)[/size]
